plain: A man named Tim Alberino told podcast host Jesse Michels about a book called Cydonia by a writer named David Flynn, named after a region of Mars. He says that before Flynn's daughter reprinted it, copies of the book were selling for two to three thousand dollars, showing how sought after it had become.
